title: VISPA: Pluralistic Alignment via Automatic Value Selection and Activation
abstract: arXiv:2601.12758v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As large language models are increasingly used in high-stakes domains, it is essential that their outputs reflect not average} human preference, rather range of varying perspectives. Achieving such pluralism, however, remains challenging. Existing approaches consider limited values or rely on prompt-level interventions, lacking value control and representation. To address this, we introduce VISPA, a training-free pluralistic alignment framework, that enables direct control over value expression by dynamic selection and internal model activation steering. Across extensive empirical studies spanning multiple models and evaluation settings, we show VISPA is performant across all pluralistic alignment modes in healthcare and beyond. Further analysis reveals VISPA is adaptable with different steering initiations, model, and/or values. translated_title: VISPA：通过自动价值选择与激活实现多元对齐
translated_abstract: 随着大型语言模型越来越多地被应用于高风险领域，其输出不仅应反映平均的人类偏好，还应体现多样化的不同观点，这一点至关重要。然而，实现这种多元化仍然极具挑战性。现有方法要么仅考虑有限的价值，要么依赖于提示层面的干预，缺乏对价值的控制和表征。为解决这一问题，我们提出了VISPA——一个无需训练的多元对齐框架，通过动态价值选择和内部模型激活引导，实现对价值表达的直接控制。在涵盖多个模型和评估设置的广泛实证研究中，我们展示了VISPA在医疗健康及其他领域的所有多元对齐模式中均表现优异。进一步分析表明，VISPA能够灵活适应不同的引导启动方式、模型和/或价值。这些结果表明，多元对齐可以通过内部激活机制来实现。
tldr: 提出VISPA——一个无需训练的多元对齐框架，通过动态价值选择与内部激活引导，直接控制大模型的价值表达，使其输出能够反映多元化的观点。
en_tdlr: VISPA is a training-free pluralistic alignment framework that enables direct control over value expression in large language models through dynamic value selection and internal activation steering, allowing outputs to reflect diverse perspectives.
